verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an AI Game Agent, an MCP server, and a visual editor, so asking whether agent-driven changes or automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review, history, or rollback feature for agent or editor automations. Moving project files to VS Code would be a user-side workaround, not a Phaser capability.
